titles.romaji: Yuusha Party ni Kawaii Ko ga Ita no de, Kokuhaku Shitemita.
titles.english: There was a Cute Girl in the Hero’s Party, so I Tried Confessing to Her
titles.native: 勇者パーティーにかわいい子がいたので、告白してみた。

description:
Reincarnated as a mid-tier demon, Youki had one job: Crush the hero’s party. Then he saw the party’s priestess, Cecilia, and fell for her hard. Now this lovestruck demon vows to confess his feelings, even if it means betraying the Demon King. Will love bloom between these two sworn enemies?

(Source: Crunchyroll)
